line.name: Saint Luis Rey Serie G Maduro
line.description: 'G' reportedly stands for 'gigante' (large ring gauges, 54-60). Fuller-bodied maduro line with a hand-selected Connecticut Broadleaf maduro wrapper. A separate natural-wrapper 'Serie G Natural' SKU also exists per Altadis USA's site but was not independently fetched for full specs in this pass.
